best.label: The best script a blind search found

same_seed_twice.label: Same seed, same script, run twice

numbers.label: People
numbers.moves: Up with jobs, homes and happiness. Down with unemployment and smoke.

numbers.label: Homes
numbers.moves: Built by the mayor. Caps how many people can live here.

numbers.label: Jobs
numbers.moves: Factories and subsidies add them. High tax and bad services lose them.

numbers.label: Treasury
numbers.moves: Tax in, upkeep out. Interest on debt at 8%. Below zero: austerity.

numbers.label: Pollution
numbers.moves: Factories emit 2 each, people 1 per 1000. Parks absorb a share, less each.

numbers.label: Happiness
numbers.moves: Work, homes, clean air, low tax, good services. Debt and deficit weigh on it.

numbers.label: Services
numbers.moves: Decays 4 a year unless funded. Faster when the city is broke.

levers.label: Set tax
levers.law: Revenue = rate × jobs × 3.5. Above 30%, 2% of jobs leave each year. Happiness target falls 60 × rate.

levers.label: Build housing
levers.law: People move in at half the empty homes a year. Jobs do not follow. This is the trap.

levers.label: Build factory
levers.law: +150 jobs. +2 pollution a year forever. +20 upkeep a year. Takes 2 lots.

levers.label: Build park
levers.law: Absorbs 12% of the air's pollution; each extra park 80% of the previous one's share. Never reaches zero.

levers.label: Fund transit
levers.law: −1 pollution a year per level. +40 upkeep per level.

levers.label: Fund services
levers.law: +12 points per level. Decays 4 a year regardless.

levers.label: Borrow
levers.law: Cash now, 8% interest a year forever. Refused above 5 years of revenue or 3000, whichever is higher.

info_actions.label: Consult the industrialist
info_actions.law: A real one-year forecast, then a bias: jobs ×1.25, pollution ×0.6. Speaks for the factories.

info_actions.label: Consult the economist
info_actions.law: The same forecast, then: treasury ×1.15, happiness deleted. Speaks for the budget.

info_actions.label: Hold a referendum
info_actions.law: Approval % = happiness + the lever's popularity + noise. Citizens hate taxes, love parks.

info_actions.label: Read last year's report
info_actions.law: Every change last year with the decision that caused it.
